sloka: ततो दुःखतरं भूयः सीताया विप्रवासनम् ।पौराणां वचनं श्रुत्वा नृशंसं प्रतिभाति मे ।। ७.५०.७ ॥
transliteration: tato duḥkhataraṁ bhūyaḥ sītāyā vipravāsanam ।paurāṇāṁ vacanaṁ śrutvā nṛśaṁsaṁ pratibhāti me ।। 7.50.7 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the citizens, Sita's banishment appears to me even more sorrowful than his previous sufferings, and indeed cruel.
